open_questions.description: What the twenty-five Euro selling price converts to in Pounds

notes: Almost the whole case is the AMI icebreaker (each participant draws a favourite animal), which is real speech carrying no project content -- three categories are correctly empty. The twenty-five Euro selling price at seg-0045 is reported as an existing constraint, not settled here, so it is not a decision; the conversion question attached to it is asked and never answered.
